comment: 虚拟展厅卡片配置文件。新增/修改卡片只需编辑本文件并上传到 /plugins/virtual-showroom/cards.json，无需重新构建插件。
Card config for the Virtual Showroom plugin. Add or edit cards here and upload cards.json — no plugin rebuild required.
字段说明 / Field notes: order 排序(小在前), enabled=false 隐藏, image 相对本插件目录, openIn: new-tab|same-tab

cards.title: Observation Demo（A2A-T 展屏）
cards.description: OpenAN 编排专业化智能体端到端协作，贯通呼叫中心、计费、CDN 与 NOC，实现投诉自主闭环处置；内置 WAIMO 故障分类定界与专线投诉动态编排两个案例，支持故事线回放。
cards.descriptionEn: OpenAN orchestrates specialized agents end-to-end — bridging call centers, billing, CDN and NOC for autonomous complaint resolution, with storyline replay of two end-to-end cases.

cards.title: Ontology Showcase（本体应用演示）
cards.description: 以本体驱动的应用编排演示（广东 POC）：输入自然语言任务，实时呈现本体检索、应用编排与执行全流程事件流。
cards.descriptionEn: Ontology-driven application demo (Guangdong POC): type a natural-language task and watch ontology retrieval, application orchestration and execution as a live event stream.

cards.title: Live Assurance Demo（大型赛事直播业务保障）
cards.titleEn: Major-event Live Broadcast Emergency Assurance Demo
cards.description: 城市马拉松赛事直播保障闭环：直播智能体解析赛事需求并订阅保障服务，保障智能体生成策略，RAN 智能体执行功率提升时发现节能 SLA 冲突并经 A2A-T 协商关闭一半节能任务；KQI 劣化后关闭全部节能并跨站协同优化，KQI 恢复后恢复初始配置。点击卡片选择驱动模式（默认 Agent 执行 · 真实 mockAgent 服务，或 Demo 回放 · 不拉起 Agent）、Agent 答复模式三选一（剧本回放·固定文本（默认）/ 数据集匹配·模板检索 / LLM 生成·未配 key 自动降级），后两者由 Playground 打桩实例实时生成应答）与智能体启动选项后拉起场景框架页面，PSOP 流程与多智能体团队随场景自动注入，首次拉起后页面持续驻留。
cards.descriptionEn: City-marathon live broadcast assurance closed loop: the Live Streaming Agent parses event requirements and subscribes to assurance, the Assurance Agent generates the policy, the RAN Agent discovers an energy-saving SLA conflict and closes half of the energy-saving tasks via A2A-T negotiation; KQI degradation triggers a full energy-saving shutdown with inter-site coordinated optimization, and the initial configuration is restored after recovery. Clicking the card opens launch options (default: Agent Run via the real mockAgent service; or Demo Replay with no agent launch), an Agent reply mode (three content-source modes: bank replay (fixed text, default) / dataset matching (template retrieval) / LLM generation (auto-degrades without a key)), and agent startup selection (applies to Agent Run only), then launches the scenario framework page with the PSOP workflow and multi-agent team injected; after the first launch the page stays alive.
